svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform — Solution Vision
what the bank loses today, what the platform changes, and exactly where R0 stops · scope per DEC-20260816-03 (Product), assisted-first
WHAT IS BROKEN TODAY — EACH LINE IS A LOSS THE BANK CAN MEASURE
the customer leaves for the insurer's site and the bank
learns the outcome later, from a file
RM, operations and the customer each hold a different version
consent, suitability, payment and issuance proof sit in four
adding a product means re-cutting the journey around a
a failure between quote, proposal, payment and issuance is
found by a human reading a report
no context is the stated golden source, so no number is
WHAT THE PLATFORM IS — FIVE COMMITMENTS THAT DO NOT BEND FOR A RELEASE DATE
partner formats are translated at one boundary (#14); no insurer message
each context owns its rules and its golden data; no context reads another's
C1 suitability, C2 consent and C4 payment isolation are enforced in code
issuance ∧ reconciliation ∧ audit completeness (INV-JRN-05) — no other route
one journey proven end to end beats six journeys half-built; expansion is
WHAT CHANGES — AND THE MEASURE THAT PROVES IT (BASELINES ARE PRODUCT'S TO SET)
journey stage is a single value
% of journeys with a stage younger than 60 s
C1/C2 evidence exists before the quote
% of quotes with a valid unexpired suitability ref
target: 100% — a gate, not a KPI
% of payments resolved without manual touch
baseline to be set from PG history
elapsed days to add the second Group A insurer
every break becomes a named task
% of breaks with an owner inside SLA
% of report fields traceable to an owning context
WHERE R0 STOPS — THE BOUNDARY IS A PRODUCT DECISION, NOT AN ARCHITECTURE PREFERENCE
1 RM · 1 ETB customer · 1 Term Life product · 1 Group A insurer
RM-assisted only — the customer never self-serves in R0
consent (C2) and suitability (C1) mandatory and evidenced
payment on the customer's own device (C4), reconciled before sold
policy issued, document retrievable, audit chain complete
12 services + 1 Flutter app — not the 19-context target
DEC-20260816-04 · GAP-023 re-scoped to R1 entry
self-service (DIY) journey revisits — needs a customer identity decision
second Group A insurer — proves the seam was real
Group B redirect + catalogue (R0-SCOPE A5) lands here
Lead module beyond a customer lookup
entry condition: GATE-S11 passed for the R0 Term journey
no decision recorded — do not design for it yet
further life products, then further lines of business
customer BFF, reporting & MIS, admin UI
EXPLICITLY NOT IN R0 — WRITTEN DOWN SO IT IS A DECISION, NEVER A DISCOVERY
WHAT THIS DOCUMENT ASKS STAKEHOLDERS TO DECIDE
Confirm the target vision and the bank-owned-journey principle
Confirm the R0 boundary as stated (re-affirms DEC-20260816-03)
Confirm C1/C2/C4 and INV-JRN-05 as non-waivable by any authority
Confirm phased delivery, and that R1 scope is not designed for in R0
Confirm the measures above are the ones the pilot is judged on
